# `csharp_blank_lines_around_namespace`

Blank lines before and after a namespace declaration.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `<integer>` | Any integer. |

**Default:** `0`

## Examples

*This option accepts a freeform value. No canned example is generated.*

```ini
csharp_blank_lines_around_namespace = <value>
```
